# jamfplatform_pro_category (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro category by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_category" "example_by_id" {
  id = "5"
}

output "category_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_category.example_by_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Category ID to look up.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Category display name.
- `priority` (Number) Sort priority, 1–20. Lower numbers sort first.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
